subject: Compact/restore + lane health evidence request
body: Submit an evidence packet: (1) heartbeat status + timestamp, (2) compact runner status (consistent/diverged), (3) last compact evidence paths: POST_COMPACT_AUDIT.json, RECOVERY_TEST_RESULTS.json, meta.json, (4) current single blocker, (5) requested operator/archivist decision in one line. No governance-state mutation; report only evidence-backed claims.
